description: This file defines the XmlWriter class, which provides utility methods for writing XML documents with proper indentation, attribute handling, and escaping special characters. It simplifies the process of generating well-formed XML programmatically.

classes.name: XmlWriter
classes.description: A utility class for writing XML content with indentation, attribute management, and character escaping. Implements Closeable to ensure proper resource management.

methods.name: XmlWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes XmlWriter with an existing Writer, ownership flag, indentation offset, and whether to add XML prefix.

methods.name: XmlWriter
methods.description: Constructor that creates an XmlWriter wrapping an OutputStream, using UTF-8 charset.

methods.name: writeEntity
methods.description: Starts a new XML element with the given name, handling indentation and stack management.

methods.name: closeOpeningTag
methods.description: Closes the start tag of an element, writing attributes and optional newline.

methods.name: writeAttributes
methods.description: Writes all accumulated attributes to the output and resets the attribute buffer.

methods.name: writeAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the current element, escaping special XML characters in the value.

methods.name: endEntity
methods.description: Closes the current XML element, handling empty elements and indentation.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the XmlWriter, flushing and closing the underlying writer if owned, and ensuring all tags are closed.

methods.name: writeText
methods.description: Writes text content inside an element, escaping special characters.
